tasks.title: Initialize Project Repository
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with Python 3.12 and TypeScript 5 support.
tasks.details: Create a new repository. Setup basic directory structure: collectors/, canonizer/, storage/, kpi/, chatgpt/. Initialize Python environment with `venv` and install necessary packages. Configure TypeScript environment with `tsconfig.json`.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the project structure and initial setup by manually inspecting the created directories and files. Run `python --version` and `tsc --version` to confirm the correct versions.

tasks.title: Implement VALORANT Real-time Collector
tasks.description: Implement the Overwolf real-time collector for VALORANT using TypeScript and WebSockets.
tasks.details: Create `collector/overwolf-val.ts`. Implement `EventListener` to capture game events via Overwolf GEP. Handle WebSocket connections. Implement data parsing and queueing to local queue. Use `FileRotator` for log management.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate VALORANT game events and verify that the collector captures and queues the data correctly. Check log rotation.

tasks.title: Implement Overwatch 2 Real-time Collector
tasks.description: Implement the Overwolf real-time collector for Overwatch 2 using TypeScript and Python.
tasks.details: Create `collector/overwolf-ow2.ts` and `collector/ow2_log_parser.py`. Implement `EventListener` in TS to capture GEP events. Create Python script to parse `Overwatch.log` for missing events. Combine data streams. Queue data to local queue.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate Overwatch 2 game events and verify that the collector captures and merges GEP and log data correctly. Verify event completeness.

tasks.title: Implement Apex Legends Real-time Collector
tasks.description: Implement the Overwolf real-time collector for Apex Legends using TypeScript and WebSockets.
tasks.details: Create `collector/overwolf-apex.ts`. Implement `EventListener` to capture game events via Overwolf GEP. Handle WebSocket connections. Implement data parsing and queueing to local queue. Capture ring information.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate Apex Legends game events and verify that the collector captures and queues the data correctly. Check ring information capture.

tasks.title: Implement League of Legends Match Data Fetcher
tasks.description: Implement the Riot API fetcher for League of Legends match data.
tasks.details: Create `collector/riot_fetcher.py`. Implement `MatchPoller` to fetch match IDs. Implement `TimelineFetcher` to fetch match timeline data using `riotwatcher`. Handle rate limits (20 req/2 min).
tasks.testStrategy: Fetch LoL match and timeline data using the Riot API. Verify data integrity and rate limit handling.

tasks.title: Implement Street Fighter 6 Replay Parser
tasks.description: Implement the replay parser for Street Fighter 6 replay files.
tasks.details: Create `collector/replay_parser.py`. Use `replay_to_json` tool to convert replay.bin files to JSON. Implement `BinParser` and `FrameMapper` to process the JSON data.
tasks.testStrategy: Parse SF6 replay files and verify the extracted JSON data against expected values.

tasks.title: Implement Splatoon 3 Data Fetcher
tasks.description: Implement the Splatoon 3 data fetcher using the SplatNet3 API.
tasks.details: Create `collector/splatoon_fetcher.py`. Use `s3s` wrapper to interact with SplatNet3 API. Implement `BattleFetcher` to retrieve battle data.
tasks.testStrategy: Fetch Splatoon 3 battle data using the SplatNet3 API. Verify data integrity.

tasks.title: Implement Pokémon UNITE Data Fetcher
tasks.description: Implement the Pokémon UNITE data fetcher using the uniteapi.dev API.
tasks.details: Create `collector/unite_fetcher.py`. Use Python to interact with the uniteapi.dev API. Fetch match data.
tasks.testStrategy: Fetch Pokémon UNITE match data using the uniteapi.dev API. Verify data integrity.

tasks.title: Implement Marvel Rivals Data Fetcher (OCR)
tasks.description: Implement the Marvel Rivals data fetcher using Screen OCR (temporary solution).
tasks.details: Create `collector/marvel_rivals_fetcher.py`. Implement Screen OCR using Python libraries. Extract relevant game data.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the OCR script on Marvel Rivals screenshots and verify the extracted data.

tasks.title: Implement Canonizer Module
tasks.description: Implement the Canonizer module with factory and specific canonizers for each game.
tasks.details: Create `canonizer/canonizer.py`. Implement `CanonizerFactory` to create specific canonizers. Implement `LoLCanonizer`, `ValCanonizer`, etc. Implement the common schema v1.0.
tasks.testStrategy: Test each canonizer with sample game data and verify that the output conforms to the common schema v1.0.

tasks.title: Implement SQLite Storage
tasks.description: Implement SQLite storage with the defined table schema.
tasks.details: Create `storage/sqlite_store.py`. Implement functions to create and interact with the SQLite database (`data/esports.db`). Create `match` and `event` tables as defined in the schema.
tasks.testStrategy: Insert sample data into the SQLite database and verify that the data is stored correctly. Query the database to retrieve the data.

tasks.title: Implement Google Sheets Storage
tasks.description: Implement Google Sheets storage using the Google Sheets API v4.
tasks.details: Create `storage/google_sheets_store.py`. Implement `GoogleSheetsStore` class to interact with the Google Sheets API. Implement functions to write data to a specified sheet.
tasks.testStrategy: Write sample data to a Google Sheet and verify that the data is stored correctly.

tasks.title: Implement KPI Job
tasks.description: Implement the KPI Job to calculate weekly KPIs.
tasks.details: Create `kpi/kpi_builder.py`. Implement functions to calculate KPIs such as CS/10min, First-Death%, Avg StunTime, RingDelaySec. Schedule the job to run weekly using cron (`0 3 * * 1` JST).
tasks.testStrategy: Run the KPI job and verify that the KPIs are calculated correctly. Check the cron schedule.

tasks.title: Implement ChatGPT Prompt Builder
tasks.description: Implement the ChatGPT Prompt Builder to summarize KPIs and recent events.
tasks.details: Create `chatgpt/prompt_builder.py`. Implement functions to summarize KPIs and recent events from the last 3 matches. Format the data into a prompt for ChatGPT.
tasks.testStrategy: Generate prompts with sample data and verify that the prompts contain the correct information.

tasks.title: Implement API Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement error handling for API 429 errors with exponential backoff and Slack Webhook notifications.
tasks.details: Implement error handling in `riot_fetcher.py`. Use `try/except` blocks to catch API 429 errors. Implement exponential backoff retry mechanism. Send notifications to Slack using a Webhook.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate API 429 errors and verify that the retry mechanism and Slack notifications work correctly.

tasks.title: Implement GEP Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement error handling for GEP event loss with heartbeat monitoring and automatic reconnection.
tasks.details: Implement heartbeat monitoring in `overwolf-val.ts`, `overwolf-ow2.ts`, and `overwolf-apex.ts`. Monitor for event loss every 60 seconds. Implement automatic reconnection on event loss. Send local notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate GEP event loss and verify that the heartbeat monitoring and automatic reconnection work correctly. Check local notifications.

tasks.title: Implement Canonizer Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement error handling for Canonizer exceptions with Sentry integration.
tasks.details: Implement `try/except` blocks in `canonizer.py`. Integrate with Sentry to report exceptions.
tasks.testStrategy: Simulate Canonizer exceptions and verify that the exceptions are reported to Sentry.

tasks.title: Implement CLI
tasks.description: Implement CLI using Python to pull all API data, run GEP collectors, and build KPIs.
tasks.details: Create `cli.py`. Implement `pull-all` command to fetch API data. Implement `run-gep` command to start RT collectors. Implement `build-kpi` command to calculate KPIs.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the CLI commands and verify that they perform the expected actions.

tasks.title: Create Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml
tasks.description: Create a Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml for containerization.
tasks.details: Create a Dockerfile to build a Docker image for the application. Create a docker-compose.yml file to define the services and dependencies.
tasks.testStrategy: Build the Docker image and run the application using docker-compose. Verify that the application runs correctly in the container.

tasks.title: Setup CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Setup CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions for automated testing and Docker build.
tasks.details: Create GitHub Actions workflows for running tests on push and building/pushing Docker images on merge to main.
tasks.testStrategy: Trigger the GitHub Actions workflows and verify that the tests pass and the Docker images are built and pushed correctly.

tasks.title: Implement KPI Upload to Google Sheets
tasks.description: Implement uploading KPI results to Google Sheets.
tasks.details: Modify `kpi_builder.py` to upload the calculated KPIs to a specified Google Sheet using the Google Sheets API.
tasks.testStrategy: Run the KPI job and verify that the KPI results are uploaded to the correct Google Sheet.

tasks.title: Configure Slack Webhook
tasks.description: Configure Slack Webhook for notifications.
tasks.details: Set up a Slack Webhook and configure the application to send notifications to the Webhook URL.
tasks.testStrategy: Trigger events that should send Slack notifications and verify that the notifications are received in the Slack channel.

tasks.title: Integrate ChatGPT API
tasks.description: Integrate ChatGPT API for generating feedback.
tasks.details: Use OpenAI SDK or local call to ChatGPT to generate feedback based on the prompt built by `prompt_builder.py`.
tasks.testStrategy: Send prompts to ChatGPT and verify that the generated feedback is relevant and useful.

tasks.title: Implement Weekly KPI Visualization
tasks.description: Implement weekly KPI visualization.
tasks.details: Create scripts or use existing tools to visualize the weekly KPIs. Store the visualizations in a suitable format (e.g., images, dashboards).
tasks.testStrategy: Generate KPI visualizations and verify that they accurately represent the KPI data.

tasks.title: Test Local and Docker Deployment
tasks.description: Test local and Docker deployment.
tasks.details: Test the application deployment locally using `make venv` and in Docker using `docker-compose`. Verify that all components work correctly in both environments.
tasks.testStrategy: Deploy the application locally and in Docker and verify that all components function as expected.

tasks.title: Create Unit Tests for Fetcher, Canonizer, and KPI Functionalities
tasks.description: Create unit tests for the fetcher, canonizer, and KPI functionalities. Develop a comprehensive test suite using pytest to ensure thorough testing of LoLFetcher, LoLCanonizer, and KPI calculation features, aiming for at least 80% test coverage.
tasks.details:
1.  Set up pytest in the project.
2.  Create test files for each module: `test_fetcher.py`, `test_canonizer.py`, and `test_kpi.py`.
3.  Write test cases for `LoLFetcher` to verify data fetching from the Riot API, including handling of rate limits and data integrity.
4.  Write test cases for `LoLCanonizer` to ensure data transformation to the common schema v1.0.
5.  Write test cases for the KPI calculation functions in `kpi_builder.py` to verify the accuracy of calculated KPIs such as CS/10min, First-Death%, Avg StunTime, and RingDelaySec.
6.  Use pytest fixtures to set up test environments and mock external API calls.
7.  Implement test coverage measurement using pytest-cov.
8.  Ensure that the test suite covers at least 80% of the code in the fetcher, canonizer, and KPI modules.
9.  Integrate tests into the CI/CD pipeline to run automatically on each commit.
tasks.testStrategy:
1.  Run pytest with coverage measurement: `pytest --cov=./ --cov-report term-missing`.
2.  Verify that all tests pass without errors.
3.  Check the test coverage report to ensure that it is at least 80% for the fetcher, canonizer, and KPI modules.
4.  Manually inspect the test cases to ensure that they cover all critical functionalities and edge cases.
5.  Use mutation testing to assess the quality of the tests.
6.  Monitor test execution time and optimize tests for performance.

tasks.title: Implement OpenRouter Configuration Management
tasks.description: Implement a configuration management feature for OpenRouter, including API key management, model selection, fallback settings, and rate limiting. This system will securely manage the integration with the OpenRouter API and support multiple LLM models.
tasks.details:
1.  Create a new module `openrouter_config.py` to manage OpenRouter settings.
2.  Implement API key management with secure storage and retrieval.
3.  Develop a user interface (UI) or CLI for model selection, allowing users to choose from available LLM models.
4.  Implement fallback settings to specify alternative models if the primary model fails.
5.  Integrate rate limiting to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage of the OpenRouter API.
6.  Ensure secure communication and data handling with the OpenRouter API.
7.  Store the configuration in SQLite (using task 11) for persistence.
8.  Integrate with ChatGPT API (task 23) to test model configurations and fallback scenarios.
9.  Consider using environment variables for sensitive information like API keys.
tasks.testStrategy:
1.  Test API key management by creating, updating, and deleting API keys.
2.  Verify model selection by switching between different LLM models and ensuring the application uses the selected model.
3.  Test fallback settings by simulating model failures and verifying that the application falls back to the specified alternative model.
4.  Test rate limiting by sending multiple requests and verifying that the rate limits are enforced.
5.  Monitor API usage and error logs to ensure proper integration with the OpenRouter API.
6.  Validate that the configuration is stored correctly in SQLite and can be retrieved.
7.  Use ChatGPT API to validate the functionality of the selected model.

tasks.title: Implement Code Modularization Based on Design Document
tasks.description: Refactor the codebase by modularizing the existing single-file log_pipeline.py into a structured project with collectors/, canonizer/, storage/, kpi/, and llm/ directories.
tasks.details:
1. Create the directories: collectors/, canonizer/, storage/, kpi/, and llm/.
2. Analyze the existing log_pipeline.py to identify logical modules and their dependencies.
3. Move relevant code sections into appropriately named files within the new directories (e.g., collector-related code into collectors/).
4. Implement necessary inter-module communication mechanisms, ensuring each module maintains independence while being able to interact with others.
5. Update import statements and references to reflect the new module structure.
6. Ensure that the main execution flow is preserved after the refactoring.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Run existing tests to ensure that the refactored code maintains the same functionality as the original.
2. Create new integration tests to verify the interactions between the different modules.
3. Manually inspect the code to ensure that the modularization has improved code readability and maintainability.
4. Verify that the project structure adheres to the specified directory structure.

tasks.title: Implement VALCanonizer, ApexCanonizer, OW2Canonizer and Finalize CanonizerFactory
tasks.description: Extend the Canonizer module by implementing VALCanonizer, ApexCanonizer, and OW2Canonizer based on the LoL-specific implementation. Finalize the CanonizerFactory to support all game titles and ensure data normalization to a unified format using the common event schema.
tasks.details:
1. Implement `VALCanonizer`, `ApexCanonizer`, and `OW2Canonizer` classes, inheriting from a common base class or interface to ensure consistency.
2. Modify `CanonizerFactory` to dynamically create instances of the new canonizers based on the game title.
3. Ensure each canonizer transforms game-specific data into the common event schema v1.0.
4. Implement robust error handling within each canonizer, leveraging the existing Sentry integration.
5. Refactor common logic into shared utility functions to reduce code duplication and improve maintainability.
6. Update the module structure to accommodate the new canonizers, ensuring clear separation of concerns.
7. Document the implementation details and usage of each canonizer in the project's documentation.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Create unit tests for `VALCanonizer`, `ApexCanonizer`, and `OW2Canonizer` to verify correct data transformation.
2. Test the `CanonizerFactory` to ensure it correctly instantiates the appropriate canonizer for each game title.
3. Validate that the output of each canonizer conforms to the common event schema v1.0 using schema validation tools.
4. Simulate error conditions and verify that exceptions are correctly handled and reported to Sentry.
5. Measure test coverage to ensure that all new code is adequately tested (aim for at least 80% coverage).
6. Perform integration tests to verify the end-to-end data pipeline with the new canonizers.

tasks.title: Generalize and Extend KPI Calculation Functionality for Multiple Games
tasks.description: Extend the KPI calculation functionality to support multiple games (VALORANT, Apex Legends, Overwatch 2, etc.) by generalizing the existing LoL-specific KPI calculations. Build a comprehensive KPI system that integrates game-agnostic and game-specific performance metrics.
tasks.details:
1.  Refactor the existing KPI calculation logic in `kpi_builder.py` to support multiple games.
2.  Implement game-specific KPI calculation functions for VALORANT, Apex Legends, and Overwatch 2, considering the unique metrics and gameplay mechanics of each game.
3.  Create a configuration system to define and manage game-specific KPIs, allowing for easy addition or modification of KPIs without code changes.
4.  Integrate the new game-specific KPI calculations with the existing data pipeline, ensuring that the correct KPIs are calculated based on the game being processed.
5.  Develop a unified data model to represent both game-agnostic and game-specific KPIs, facilitating consistent storage and retrieval.
6.  Update the KPI job scheduler to trigger game-specific KPI calculations based on the available data.
7.  Ensure that the system is scalable and can handle a large number of games and KPIs without performance degradation.
tasks.testStrategy:
1.  Create unit tests for each game-specific KPI calculation function to verify the accuracy of the calculated KPIs.
2.  Develop integration tests to ensure that the game-specific KPI calculations are correctly integrated with the data pipeline and storage.
3.  Test the configuration system to verify that game-specific KPIs can be easily added, modified, or removed without code changes.
4.  Run end-to-end tests to verify that the KPI job scheduler triggers the correct game-specific KPI calculations based on the available data.
5.  Monitor the system performance to ensure that it can handle a large number of games and KPIs without performance degradation.
6.  Validate the calculated KPIs against known benchmarks and expert analysis to ensure their accuracy and relevance.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Configuration Management System
tasks.description: Implement a comprehensive configuration management system that integrates YAML/JSON configuration files, environment variables, API key management, game-specific settings, rate limiting settings, and log settings. Extend the existing ConfigManager to build a robust configuration system suitable for production.
tasks.details:
1.  Implement a new configuration management module that supports loading configurations from YAML/JSON files, environment variables, and secure storage for API keys.
2.  Extend the existing `ConfigManager` class to integrate with the new configuration module.
3.  Implement a mechanism to manage game-specific settings, allowing different configurations for VALORANT, Apex Legends, Overwatch 2, etc.
4.  Implement rate limiting settings to control API usage and prevent abuse.
5.  Implement log settings to configure logging levels, output destinations, and log rotation policies.
6.  Ensure that all configurations are validated and that appropriate error handling is in place.
7.  Implement a user interface (UI) or CLI for managing configurations, allowing users to easily update settings without code changes.
8.  Securely store and manage API keys, using encryption and access controls to protect sensitive information.
9.  Integrate with existing monitoring and alerting systems to notify administrators of configuration changes or errors.
tasks.testStrategy:
1.  Create unit tests to verify that the configuration management system can load configurations from YAML/JSON files, environment variables, and secure storage.
2.  Test the integration with the existing `ConfigManager` class to ensure that it correctly retrieves and applies configurations.
3.  Verify that game-specific settings are correctly applied for different games.
4.  Test rate limiting settings to ensure that API usage is controlled as expected.
5.  Test log settings to ensure that logging is configured correctly and that logs are being written to the appropriate destinations.
6.  Test the UI or CLI for managing configurations, ensuring that users can easily update settings and that changes are applied correctly.
7.  Test API key management to ensure that API keys are securely stored and retrieved.
8.  Simulate configuration changes and errors to verify that the monitoring and alerting systems are working correctly.
